item.title: DarkHaven - Walkthrough
item.description:
Overview Platform: HackMyVM Difficulty: Medium OS: Windows Attacker IP: 10.200.84.107 Target IP: 10.0.23.202

The objective was to assess DarkHaven’s Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) portal and underlying Windows environment. The initial credentials provided were intended to give access to a low-privileged VDI session. From there, the objective was to escape the restricted VDI environment, obtain local access, enumerate sensitive information, and ultimately escalate privileges to an administrative account.
